description: Every firewall `tags` member is written as `allOf: [$ref existing_tags_array, { description }]`. The converter cannot merge an array $ref with a description-only member and emits `unknown`. Replace each with the inlined array of strings so the SDK types `tags` as `Array<string>` on the firewall, on every rule target, and on the add/remove tags request bodies.

value.description:
An array containing the names of the Tags assigned to the firewall.

Requires `tag:read` scope.
An array containing the names of Tags corresponding to groups of Droplets to which the firewall will allow traffic.
An array containing the names of the Tags to be assigned to the firewall.
An array containing the names of the Tags to be removed from the firewall.
